events.summary: Students will learn how to use ChatGPT’s API to build their own chat bot, as well as other use cases. This is part 2 of a 2 part series.

events.title: Introduction to AWS - Part 1
events.summary: Students will learn about AWS, a cloud computing service provided by Amazon and learn about its use case, and its importance in the current Software Engineering field. They will also learn about other AWS services like S3 Buckets, SQS, SNS, and Lambda functions. This will be the first part of a 2 part series.

events.title: Hands on with AWS - Part 2
events.summary: Students will learn how to implement AWS services like S3 Buckets, SQS, Lambda Functions, SNS, and possibly a PostgresQL database with Python, which is a high-level programming language (or React) This will be the second part of a 2 part series.
